newsitem.title: CHINA: China's first private bank opens Guangzhou branch.
newsitem.headline: China's first private bank opens Guangzhou branch.

text.p: The China Minsheng Banking Corporation, China's first joint-stock commercial bank, has opened a branch in the southern boomtown of Guangzhou, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
The branch, which opened on Wednesday, is Minsheng bank's first outside Beijing.
The bank was set up last January with a registered capital of 380 million yuan, more than 80 percent of which has come from non-state-owned businesses.

The new branch in Guangzhou, capital of Guangdong province that abuts Hong Kong, will mainly provide loans to the private sector and assist the real estate and science and technology sectors, Xinhua said.
The branch was expected to play an important role in economic expansion in Guangdong where non-state enterprises account for about one-third of the provincial total, it said.
